done_when: A git-ignored forge.local.toml beside forge.toml, read from the main checkout so every task and fix worktree of that clone uses it, overrides only which tools run work, the worker split and the model and effort per kind of work; Forge refuses any other key in it; new and upgraded repos ignore the file in git; forge next and forge doctor show which file each of those settings came from

findings.body: Raise: Not done. On a prototype fix, `forge work` treats the fix as design work when its state says `Prototype before sign-off` (`src/forge/worker.py:97`), but this new `forge next` path sets `design` to false for every fix. With local `workers = "split"`, `forge next` says Codex will build the fix while `forge work` selects Claude and its design model. The kind calculation at line 718 also labels a non-design Claude retry as `models.fix`, although `forge work` continues to use `models.build` for a task or `models.lite` for a fix (`src/forge/worker.py:102–110`). Thus the required source display can name the wrong worker or model file on normal fix and retry paths; the named test covers only a started, non-prototype fix.
findings.title: Not done: forge next misidentifies prototype fix workers and Claude retry model sources

findings.body: Raise: Not done. The new doctor note lists every local model kind as coming from `forge.local.toml` and says everything else comes from `forge.toml`, without checking the selected worker's model entry. For example, local `tools = "claude"` plus `[models.build.codex]` replaces the shared build table, so `forge work` uses Claude's built-in build default (`src/forge/repo.py:445, 510–533`); doctor instead presents `models.build` as local and never identifies the built-in default. This is a different doctor path from the previously fixed `forge next` model-source check, and it misses the required effective source display after a worker switch.
findings.title: Not done: doctor attributes built-in model defaults to configuration files

stop.reason: Owner rule for Harm 1-2: both findings are fixed in commit 6602663; close re-reviews the current head

why: Developers on one team have different agent access, but who builds and which models live in the committed forge.toml, so one developer's switch to Codex lands in pull requests and flips teammates' settings
